fixes._comment: described_*: the part of the file that fill131.py describes (entries 1-11). If the file grows, keep these, raise expected_entries, append the new stage and give extra_fill (text / quote items for the new entries).

referee._comment: described_*: the first lines of the report that fill131.py quotes from (append-only prefix, checked). A later stage: append [name, commit] to stages and fill slots.stage5b_ii.

referee2._comment: as for referee; a later addendum: append [name, commit] to stages and fill slots.r2_add5.

_comment: open = true: the block carries the slot's open-slot words and land131.py refuses to land.
open = false: those words are replaced by the slot's fill list, joined with single spaces. Each fill item is
{"text": "<Lead text>"}  or  {"src": "<source key>", "quote": "<verbatim string>"}  (rendered as a guillemet quotation
followed by its line numbers, located by script in the WHOLE file of that source at the commit cfg names; the build fails if
the string is not found, or found more than once without "occ": <n>).
Source keys: REF1 (first referee's report), REF2 (second referee's report), FIX (fixes file), LINE (the line), PKT, PRE, R2B, B108, RES.
stage5b_ii: the first referee's stage 5b part (ii): lines L-4 to L-6, fixes entries 9-11, its FINAL line naming L-6 by sha1.
r2_add5: the second referee's Addendum 5: its final line naming L-6.
